title: Convert text labels into readable lists
goal: Use split to split text, filter out empty items, and then use join to merge.
summary: The tags of activity data are separated by commas, and repeated commas or spaces may appear when entering. Use " / " to separate tags with content when displayed.
tasks: completes labelLine(text), splits it by commas and removes the leading and trailing blanks of each item.
Remove empty items and reconnect with " / " in the original order. Returns an empty string if there is no label.

example.note: split returns an array. join only places delimiters between adjacent items.

hint: Trim first and then filter, otherwise an item containing only spaces may not be filtered.
